history1953Layer.verticalBoundary: Terrain segments follow displayed DEM; segments in horizontally valid DEM sea/no-data areas use a reference plane only to preserve 2D historical location and do not claim historical elevation.

limitations: The 1953 L500 sheets are 1:250000 controls, so absence is strong evidence only for major modern features, not minor roads, small bridges, field paths, local drains, or individual buildings.
Historical water/coast controls are source-derived coarse controls, not survey-grade shorelines.
More detailed user-provided historical maps override the 1:250000 controls locally.
The atlas envelope contains an uncovered southeast rectangle from 121.5E to 123E and 27N to 28N; no historical authority is claimed there yet.
Reference-plane rendering over current DEM sea/no-data preserves 2D historical location only and is not an elevation claim.
